chunks: And he, peace be upon him, when he entered the place of relief, would say: “Praise be to Allah, the Preserver, the One who brings to fulfilment.”

Then when he came out, he would wipe his abdomen and say: “Praise be to Allah, who removed from me its harm and left within me its strength. How great a blessing it is, one whose measure the capable cannot fully assess.”

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and gratitude directed to Allah
key_terms.الْمُؤَدِّي: the One who brings matters to completion or fulfilment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say when entering and leaving the restroom?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication and etiquette attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام when entering and leaving the place of relief. It expresses gratitude to Allah for protection, for removal of harm, and for the preservation of bodily strength, highlighting awareness of divine blessing even in ordinary bodily acts.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.40 - When Imam Ali (as) would enter the restroom, he would say:
Alhamdulillah al-Hafiz al-Mu’addi
"Praise be to Allah (swt), the Preserver and the One who brings all matters to their fulfilment."

Upon exiting, he would wipe his abdomen and say:
Alhamdulillahi alladhi akhraja ‘anni adhaahu wa abqa fiyya quwwatahu, fa ya laha min ni‘matin la yaqdiru al-qadiroona qadraha
"Praise be to Allah (swt), who has removed harm from me and left within me strength. What a blessing it is, one whose value cannot be fully appreciated by any capable of appreciation.'"
